text.markup: **Kahatere** -- {t}, Tangohia he tohu pohopā mai i te mana wairua e whakahaere nei e koe: tukuna he tohu pohopā ki runga i te mana wairua pohopā e whakaheare nei e koe.{br}I ngā wā ka hūrētia te takitini ki a koe, hangia he tohu māia.
